sentences.text: Central Gippsland Health Service reported for 2025/26 on its health and residential aged care services in Wellington Shire and its wider specialist catchment.
The health service reported achieving National Safety and Quality Health Service accreditation.

sentences.text: The health service reported securing Commonwealth funding to establish a specialist dementia care unit for the region.
sentences.section: Report by the Chief Executive Officer

sentences.text: The health service reported developing a new strategic plan with contributions from consumers, staff, clinicians, volunteers and other partners.
